outcome: Pin the launcher's final stop check with an end-to-end commit test, and give the sealed-source observation page an entry locator
acceptance: A launcher test injects a transient stop-request read failure into executeRun's commit() under the stop lock (first final read EPERM, next read returns an intent) and asserts the retained stop is surfaced, not a pass
